The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xyquine II]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Cracken Flight Group|Cracken's Flight Group]] was assigned to the base, which was under the authority of [[Watch Commander]] [[Gingal]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Battle of Xyquine II|attacked]] the base, [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] developed the [[Cracken Twist]] and led his [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] in the destruction of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Exsanguinator]]'', and not a single Rebel [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was lost during the evacuation.
